info_plist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Buff reads your workouts from Apple Health to add exercise calories to your daily log. Workout data stays on this device.
info_plist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Buff uses Apple Health only to read your workouts for your daily exercise calories. Buff does not save or update data in Apple Health.
